base_envelope_shape.edges: must be a list and every element must satisfy GenericEdgeShape
base_envelope_shape.ordering: GenericEnvelopeShape is decided before supported/unsupported spec_id dispatch
base_envelope_shape.string_members: spec_id, artifact_type, and version must be nonempty strings

closure_algorithm: derive the direct operational role map from record mode/family and pinned validator configuration
require the signed trace operational_reference_map to equal that derived map
resolve each hash from the immutable ArtifactIndex snapshot
return UNKNOWN without traversal for a complete unsupported envelope
for supported envelopes only, validate direct field roles, version, semantic discriminator and SupportedEdgeRelation
walk supported role-bearing edges breadth-first with cycle detection
validate resolved supported child envelope type when expected_type is not opaque-content
require resolved_evidence_hashes to equal the fixed-point closure

edge_shape.generic_syntax: defined by judgments.GenericEdgeShape and applicable to all envelopes
edge_shape.supported_relation: defined by judgments.SupportedEdgeRelation and applicable iff spec_id is supported

envelope_classification_order: artifact without artifact_envelope is an opaque leaf
if GenericEnvelopeShape holds and spec_id is unsupported, classify Unsupported/UNKNOWN without SupportedEdgeRelation
if spec_id is supported, require supported version and artifact_type then apply SupportedEdgeRelation
traverse only a supported well-typed envelope

constraints: sha256 is a syntactically valid SHA-256 content address
role is unique within the parent envelope
does_not_require: artifact_type is present in the current EDGE_RELATIONS domain
role is present in a current parent-type relation
expected_type equals a current parent-role target type
GenericEdgeShape.quantifier: for every edge in every artifact_envelope before spec_id dispatch

SupportedEnvelopeHeader.predicate: envelope.version equals 0.2.4 and envelope.artifact_type is in the current EDGE_RELATIONS domain

SupportedEdgeRelation.not_applicable_when: the complete generic envelope has an unsupported spec_id or SupportedEnvelopeHeader fails
SupportedEdgeRelation.predicate: EDGE_RELATIONS[artifact_type][role] equals expected_type for every edge

UnsupportedEnvelope.predicate: GenericEnvelopeShape holds and spec_id is not the supported closure spec_id
UnsupportedEnvelope.traversal: do not traverse edges because their semantics are outside this validator version

normative_precedence: The judgments object in this artifact is normative for envelope classification. Prose summaries and executable fixtures are derived views.
